title: Small ideas. Wide horizons.
headline:
Small ideas.
Wide horizons.
scene: Macro sculptural satin folds in peach, hot pink and amber occupy upper-left and right edges like a softly lit landscape. Deep burgundy calm negative space near lower-center supports very large ivory editorial serif headline, left aligned. Warm cinematic light, fine fabric-like microtexture, no objects or people, elegant small AURA wordmark top-left.
